title: Drosophila adult ventral nervous system template and painted domains
description:
Painted neuropil and tract domains for the adult Drosophila melanogaster ventral nervous system, as served by Virtual Fly Brain.

Court2017/ holds the domain set from the preprint version of the nomenclature, painted on the Court2018 adult VNS template and served on VFB as COURT2018VNS (VFB_00100000). Court2020/ holds the final published domain set, painted by David Shepherd for Court et al. 2020 on the Janelia JRC2018 VNC Female template and served against JRC2018UnisexVNC (VFB_00200000). bridging/ holds CMTK warp fields registering between the Court2018 VNS template and the JRC2018 VNC Female, Male and Unisex spaces.

Third-party material: the JRC2018 VNC templates under JRC2018_VNC_FEMALE/ and Court2020/template/ are the work of Janelia Research Campus and are redistributed under Janelia's own CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms, which this deposit does not and cannot remove. See LICENSE-NOTES.md in the archive.
